title: Senate language on historical exotic technology antecedents (Lockheed's basement)
summary: Matthew Pines tells of Senate language on historical exotic technology antecedents (Lockheed's basement), about 2023-2024 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: if you read the language in, you know, it's come out of the the Senate, you know, in order to mitigate the possibility of of foreign technology surprise, the US government must broaden awareness of quote historical exotic technology anticedants previously provided by the federal government for research and development purposes.

plain: Matthew Pines, a security analyst, points to wording in US Senate legislation from 2023 and 2024 on UAP, the government's term for UFOs. He says it calls for the government to broaden awareness of "historical exotic technology antecedents" that the government once handed to companies for research, which he links to the aerospace firm Lockheed. If true, it would hint that unusual technology has been quietly studied by private contractors for years.
